MARA’S FIELD GUIDE

Pull. Release.
Watch it fall.

  1. Grab the glowing stone. Pull left to add power, down to arc higher.
  2. Judge the arc. Fading dots show the beginning. You figure out where the stone lands.
  3. Release. Smash every red camera. Broken mounts and falling debris count too.
WOODBreaksGLASSShattersCONCRETEFallsSTEELStays put

Region tools activate on impact. Inez paints nearby armored lenses. Dex pulses cameras within 95 pixels and one matching neighbor within 190 pixels. June’s hook pulls a moving object left, then releases.

In mixed regions, use LOAD TOOL to choose before each throw. Supplies are limited. Three stars reward fewer tools. Exact goals are shown before every throw.

Arrows: aim · Space: throw · R: retry · Esc: pause · M: sound
Cancel a drag with Esc or right-click. “Fine aim” gives you sliders.
